$comment: The approved dish catalog, seeded by scripts/seed-dishes.ts.
Ingredients reference USDA FoodData Central by fdcId, NOT by description search:
a search that silently resolves 'cheese' to the wrong row would put wrong numbers
in front of a client. `note` is the description that fdcId had when this file was
written -- the seed asserts it still matches and fails loudly if a re-seed moved it.
`grams` is for ONE base serving. weekly_plan_meals.servings scales it.
allergenTags gate the catalog in SQL before anything reaches the model, so they must
be complete: gluten for pita/bulgur/flour/couscous, lactose for any dairy, sesame for
tahini and sesame seeds, nuts for tree nuts and peanuts, egg, fish.
